issues.finding: The failed entailment test drops the formula placeholder in its first occurrence, and the conclusion says merely that a complete tableau is found although an open complete branch is needed for a countermodel.
issues.proposed_resolution: Restore !A in the failed entailment statement and require an open complete branch in the translated conclusion.

issues.location: Box and Diamond tableau construction prose
issues.finding: Both examples call the ongoing countermodel construction a closed tableau, but their displayed final trees have an open complete branch.
issues.proposed_resolution: Describe both procedures as construction of a complete tableau.

issues.location: Diamond example, line 3 and rule explanation
issues.finding: The prose names true Diamond and its true rule; line 3 and both subsequent expansions are false Diamond and use the false rule.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use the false signed Diamond formula and the false Diamond rule in the explanatory prose.

issues.location: root of the middle Diamond tableau
issues.finding: The middle tableau reverses the implication, whereas its decomposition, the initial and final tableaux, and the countermodel all concern (Diamond p and Diamond q) implies Diamond(p and q).
issues.proposed_resolution: Restore the common implication at the middle tableau root.

issues.location: line 3 of the final Diamond tableau
issues.finding: The final complete tableau leaves false Diamond at line 3 unchecked although the rule has been applied to both used successors and no more prefixes arise.
issues.proposed_resolution: Mark that discharged line checked in the final tableau only.

issues.location: valuation witnesses in the Box and Diamond countermodels
issues.finding: The Box example cites lines 11 and 10 for positive p at 1.2 and q at 1.1, but these are lines 12 and 11; the Diamond example cites q at 1.1 although line 7 and the figure put q at 1.2.
issues.proposed_resolution: Correct both Box line numbers and the Diamond q prefix in the model explanations.

translation_treatment: Translated the decision procedure and both conditional countermodel examples, applying the six bounded corrections in the target and source-comparison view without changing frozen English.
